tagline: A decade of quantum on the cloud
heroDescription: A global celebration of quantum computing and the incredible community building the future. Join workshops, talks, hackathons and more!

about.heading: What is Qiskit Fall Fest?
about.description: Qiskit Fall Fest is an annual celebration of quantum computing and the community building it forward. Expect inspiring talks, hands-on workshops, hackathons, and plenty of opportunities to learn, build and connect.

items.title: Hands-on Learning
items.desc: Explore quantum concepts by building and testing real results.

items.title: Workshops & Talks
items.desc: Interactive sessions and talks from experts and industry leaders.

items.title: Community & Networking
items.desc: Meet like-minded people and collaborate on exciting ideas.

sessions.title: From Bits to Qubits — Speaker Session

items.title: Quantum Computing Fundamentals
items.desc: Learn the basics of qubits, superposition, and entanglement with hands-on exercises.

items.title: Qiskit Programming Workshop
items.desc: Dive deep into Qiskit programming with practical examples and real quantum hardware access.

items.title: Quantum Machine Learning
items.desc: Discover how quantum computing can enhance machine learning algorithms and applications.

items.title: Quantum Algorithms Deep Dive
items.desc: Explore advanced algorithms like Shor's and Grover's with implementation guidance.

items.title: Quantum Hardware Lab
items.desc: Get hands-on experience with real quantum processors and learn about hardware limitations.

items.title: Research Frontiers Panel
items.desc: Join leading researchers discussing the latest breakthroughs in quantum computing.
